## History

Patty Spofford inherited her home, Patty's Place, from her brother [Aaron](../character/aaron.md) through his will. Having never married and never expecting or wanting to visit [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) prior to turning seventy, she and her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md) agreed to rent the cottage to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) so the two women could travel abroad.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P18](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0018), [v3 ch.Place P32](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0032), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P55](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0055)_

### [Maria](../character/maria.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maria--patty.md)

[Maria](../character/maria.md) is Patty's niece, and the two ladies travel together as companions in [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visit Patty's Place to arrange renting the cottage from Miss Patty Spofford and [Maria](../character/maria.md) for the upcoming school year while they are abroad.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P18](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0018), [v3 ch.Place P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), +2 more_
